record.label: SUB-4: k3/k4 arms at their own optimal betas
record.summary: Memo Rank 2: at truth the k3/k4 arms are worth +10/+8 with positive interaction (oracle all-three = 7.09e-9 on r35). The engine's current k3/k4 supplies flip sign between nets (r100 hurt, r150 +14) at the fixed betas; grade at per-arm optimal betas after SUB-3 identifies the binding input. Recomposes N2/N3.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed when only_k3/only_k4 at optimal betas are frozen-stable on >=3 nets or shown unusable.
record.goal_path_summary: The two smaller correction channels are worth another fifth of the error at perfect inputs; check whether the improved inputs make them usable on networks they were not tuned on.
